proposed.explanation: TOD does not eliminate cars; it provides alternatives that make transit attractive. TOD places mixed-use, higher-density development within walking distance of transit, making transit access valuable (employment, shopping, services within walking distance of station). This naturally reduces car dependency through choice, not mandate. TOD creates conditions where transit is convenient; individuals choose based on their circumstances. Highway expansion increases sprawl; TOD opposes sprawl-inducing infrastructure.
